The '''Burning Way''' was a system of volcanic magma vents crafted by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] to serve as part of the prison system on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] used to keep the [[World Razer]] chained on the planet. Its functioning was known to a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] known as [[Failsafe]] who was kept in [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]] to aid in restoring the system if it was ever compromised. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Esh-kha]] [[Gore Claw]] led his warriors in a mission to free the World Razer which saw a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] official being charged with activating the Burning Way. Before activating the device, the Republic representative was confronted by the World Razer who offered advanced Rakatan technology in exchange for being allowed to escape.
